purpose: Keep an authorized campaign role alive across bounded handoffs while preserving one isolated worktree, source identity, heartbeat, and readback.

session.rule: A durable session supervises local campaign work; it does not authorize Product writes, external actions, credentials, release, push, merge, or destructive work.

handoff.identity: Every command is bound to the exact role, session, campaign, candidate, source commit, and source tree.
handoff.failure: A failed command returns an exact result and keeps the session observable; equivalent retries require a new Controller decision or a changed observation.

liveness.stale_rule: A dead or failed session is retained and is not silently replaced under the same identity.
